plugin.name: KeePass
plugin.description: Import and sync entries from KeePass databases into Termix credentials.

connect.title: Connect a KeePass database
connect.intro: Pick a .kdbx file from the KeePass folder on the server and unlock it. Termix opens it again on every sync. Connect a database you already have to give it a new password.
connect.noDatabases: There are no .kdbx files in the KeePass folder. Ask an admin to mount the share with your databases.
connect.listFailed: Could not list the KeePass folder
connect.passwordHint: Stored encrypted on the server so scheduled syncs can open the database. It is never shown again.
connect.keyFileUploadHint: Stored encrypted on the server, like the password.
connect.keyFileTooBig: That file is too big to be a key file

account.disconnectBody: Its master password is deleted from Termix. Credentials imported from it stay unless you remove them too.

groups.title: Groups to import
groups.hint: Entries in these groups, and in the groups under them, become Termix credentials, in a folder named after their group.
groups.empty: No groups in this database. Make one in KeePass, then press Refresh.
groups.missing: Not in the database any more
groups.removeMissing: Delete credentials that leave these groups
groups.removeMissingHint: Only credentials this plugin imported are ever deleted.
groups.passwordReferencesHint: Credentials get a keepass:// reference instead of the password, and Termix reads the password from the database each time a host connects. No password is stored in Termix, but connecting needs the database file to be there. Takes effect on the next sync.

sync.title: Sync
sync.manualOnly: Automatic sync is off. An admin can turn it on in Settings.
sync.skippedHint: Entries without a password are skipped.

imported.title: Imported credentials
imported.empty: Nothing imported from this database yet. Pick groups and press Sync now.

error.load: Could not load your KeePass databases

use.title: Use KeePass
use.description: Connect KeePass databases and import their entries as credentials.

databaseRoot.label: KeePass folder
databaseRoot.description: The folder on the Termix server that holds the .kdbx files, like a share mounted into the container. People can only open files inside it.

syncIntervalMinutes.label: Sync interval (minutes)
syncIntervalMinutes.description: How often every connected database is synced. 0 turns automatic sync off, so people sync by hand.

databases.syncAllFailed_one: {{count}} database failed to sync. It shows why.
databases.syncAllFailed_other: {{count}} databases failed to sync. Each shows why.
